description: The top 25 growth stocks of 2023 and of 2024 by price return (US-listed, at least $5, $1B market cap and $10M average daily dollar volume at the start of the year), with returns, bear-market drawdown, low date, first new 52-week high, RS-line timing, and volume on the low and first-new-high days as a multiple of the prior 50 sessions' average, all worked out from the daily bars.
